name: Sonic / fire

request.text: Single sonic pulse rifle shot. Immediate deep tight concussive thump with a sharp airy pressure crack, very short bending resonant metallic overtone, no long bass rumble. Exactly one trigger pull at beginning, dry close game effect, no voice, no music.
